findings.issue: The returned-bytes pointer is a phi of the empty array (0x60) and a fresh copy, so every later use stays a memory read (`mem[_3]`, `mem[_3 + 32 len mem[_3]]`) although in both arms it equals return_data.size / the return data.
findings.rule: When a phi chooses between the zero slot 0x60 (length 0) and a fresh copy of the return data, and return_data.size is 0 in the first arm, replace `mem[_3]` by return_data.size and `mem[_3 + 32 len n]` by ext_call.return_data[0 len n]; then the bubble is `revert with ext_call.return_data[0 len return_data.size]` and the return is `return ext_call.return_data[0 len return_data.size]`.
